title: How many times will Donald Trump visit Trump National Golf Club Washington, D.C. in Oct 2026? 3
rules: If Donald Trump makes exactly 3 trips to Trump National Golf Club Washington, D.C. in Oct 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary: A single visit begins when Donald Trump arrives in Trump National Golf Club Washington, D.C. and ends when Donald Trump has left Trump National Golf Club Washington, D.C. A visit need not end to be included — i.e., if Oct 2026 ends with Donald Trump still there, that visit counts for the purposes of the count. If Donald Trump is in Trump National Golf Club Washington, D.C. at the beginning of Oct 2026, that will count as a visit. Multiple separate visits during Oct 2026 count individually.

blind.reasoning: A golf tracker and press pool reports show Trump at Trump National Sterling on Oct 3, Oct 4 and Oct 12, 2026, so the count is likely already at 3. YES requires no further visit from Oct 13–31. Pre-midterm rallies (SC Oct 21, Macon GA Oct 24, plus Western travel) cut his time in DC, but he still has several weekends left and usually visits Sterling about once a week when in town.
blind.falsifier: Any reported Trump motorcade visit to the Sterling club between Oct 13 and Oct 31 (e.g., the Oct 17-18 or Oct 24-25 weekends), or Oct 3-4 being counted as one continuous visit.

final.reasoning: The midpoint (0.36) is essentially at my estimate (0.35), and the wide 0.32–0.40 spread leaves no edge on either side. I can't verify whether Trump made any Sterling visits after Oct 12, so I hold my estimate and pass.
